title: Speed, Concentration, Opacity — The CFO's Three AI Risks
subtitle: At Global Fintech Fest 2026, RBI Deputy Governor Rohit Jain named speed, concentration and opacity as the risks AI can amplify through the financial system. A payments CFO must design detect-contain-explain controls before the next board pack.
category: AI Risk, Financial Stability & CFO Controls
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 11 September 2026. Public facts from GFF 2026 (Mumbai, 8–11 September): RBI DG Rohit Jain on speed, concentration and opacity; Governor Sanjay Malhotra on data as fiduciary responsibility, 57 crore Jan Dhan accounts, more than 9 crore Atal Pension Yojana covers, about 280 billion digital transactions last year, United Fintech Forum recognised as second fintech SRO. Business Standard: UPI 24.51 billion transactions worth about Rs 29.82 trillion in August. Axis Bank CEO Amitabh Chaudhry: 18–19% credit growth may include FCNR and base effects; economists 15–16% for the year; AI personalisation in four quarters. Composite firm: Godavari Payments Ltd. Composite CFO: Meera Kulkarni.
thumbnail: RBI AT GFF 2026: SPEED. CONCENTRATION. OPACITY. IF YOU CANNOT DETECT, CONTAIN AND EXPLAIN THE MODEL, DO NOT SIGN THE CONTROL CERTIFICATE.
